prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create ONE compact minimalist logo symbol, with absolutely no letters, numbers or words.
Subject: a single electrocardiogram heartbeat line that transforms into the clear outline of a PERSON RUNNING in the center, then flows back into a normal ECG heartbeat trace on the right.
Composition: a refined horizontal mark roughly 2.5:1 in aspect ratio, centered on a landscape 1536x1024 canvas with abundant genuinely transparent clear space. Short normal ECG on the left, a dynamic but very simple recognizable runner in the center, short normal ECG on the right. ECG segments have the same horizontal baseline and just one restrained recognizable heartbeat spike each, plus brief flat sections before and after. Runner occupies the central half of the mark. The whole symbol occupies 75 percent of canvas width.
One flowing continuous monoline construction: the incoming ECG becomes the runner's body contour and limbs and the outgoing contour becomes the ECG again. The runner must be made FROM this line, integrated into it, not an independent running icon placed above a graph or a person drawn over a separate uninterrupted baseline.
The figure reads unmistakably as someone RUNNING to the right: torso leaning forward, one knee raised forward, rear leg extended backward, two naturally bent arms in counter-motion. A small circular loop for the head integrated into the line, no face or fingers or detailed shoes. Keep anatomy elegant, sparse and legible. Only the few bends needed to communicate running. Very few crossings, generous gaps between limbs. Preserve a visually continuous connection entering and leaving the runner.
Style: crisp, flat, contemporary professional brand symbol, controlled geometry, consistent medium monoline weight, rounded caps and joins, excellent small-size readability. Solid opaque single ink color EXACT #20D8F8 for all strokes. No fill inside the runner or the head loop.
Background: real RGBA transparency, alpha zero everywhere outside the cyan strokes and in all open spaces. No dark rectangle and no baked-in checkerboard.
No glow, halo, shadow, gradients, noise, texture, 3D or lighting. No text, title, slogan, labels, border, grid, framing, heart-shaped outline, medical cross, extra symbols or watermark. Just the compact ECG-to-runner-to-ECG symbol.
